parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the wheels of the trashcan, made of rubber, typically circular with a diameter of about 15 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be moved easily by rolling on the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable movement.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the second wheel of the trashcan, made of rubber, identical to the first wheel.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other wheel to balance and roll the trashcan smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable movement.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, rectangular in shape and hinged to the main body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the trashcan to contain odors and prevent debris from escaping.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, rectangular and hollow to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for storing waste materials.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the wheels and lid move relative to it.
